result.title: Global and workspace memory storage
result.description: The QBrain.AI SHALL store raw-text memories with a stable memory ID, explicit scope, and exact text round-trip semantics. Supported scopes are Global and Workspace. Global memories are visible to every workspace, while Workspace memories are visible only to their owning workspace.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A memory record has a stable ID, scope, category, raw text, version, author metadata, and created/updated timestamps.
Global memories are returned for every workspace and are not stamped with a workspace owner.
Workspace memories require an owning workspace and are not returned for any other workspace.
Removed memories are hidden from normal reads and lists without physically deleting the row.
Memory text round-trips exactly, including internal newlines and punctuation.
